svg.title: - page 1
svg.text: A styled paragraph that wraps and paginates
The same kind of paragraph, long enough to fill many lines and to run past the foot of
the page. Look for the breaks falling between words and never inside one, for no line
being sliced across the page break - a line is the unit here, and one that does not fit
moves whole - and for the text resuming on the next page rather than starting again.
